# Every maximal run of >= 64 hex digits in the staged server/index.js, reviewed as public.
# A 64-digit run is listed by value (EIP-712/ABI type hashes, curve and hash constants,
# precompile tables from viem, ox and @noble); a longer run (bytecode, lookup tables) is
# listed as sha256:<digest of the lowercased run>:<length>. mcpb.test.ts fails on any run
# not listed here, so a key embedded in the bundle cannot ship unnoticed. After a reviewed
# dependency change, regenerate from the failure message, never by copying blindly.
